generation_contract.positive_template: One {body_color} {material} {form_factor} {object_type}, a household {category}: one deep oval freestanding tub with a broad continuous rim and a plain fully enclosed outer shell. At one end, one short arched deck-mounted filler spout is physically fused into the tub rim; its single circular water outlet is clearly visible over the empty tub. The underside and exterior are smooth and contain no visible pipes, hoses, traps, valves or plumbing connectors.
generation_contract.pose_guard_prompt: Render exactly one object, centered, resting stably on a flat neutral surface against a plain seamless light-gray background. Three-quarter product view from slightly above eye level so the front and one side are both visible. The entire object fits in frame with a clear margin on every side. Physically plausible real-world proportions and construction. Even studio lighting, soft shadow directly beneath the object only. No humans, no hands, no text, no logos, no labels, no screens showing content, no cables trailing out of frame, no reflections of surroundings, no additional objects, no cropping. This is a neutral reconstruction reference for image-to-3D, not an advertisement scene.

reference_provenance.notes: Provisional typical retail dimension; measure the approved mesh before formal registration. Uniform height scaling amplifies any aspect error from reconstruction, so check the width and depth of the finalized mesh as well.
